purpose: Define provisional typed cross-domain continuation trace, admissibility-preserving handoff, trace preservation, and orientation-reference continuity without promoting observer, time, consciousness, or identity-survival claims.

unresolved_continuation.name: Unresolved Continuation
unresolved_continuation.definition: A well-formed continuation candidate whose admissibility status remains undecided at a declared projection boundary.

handoff_operator.name: Admissibility-Preserving Handoff
handoff_operator.canonical_form: H_adm(UC_i, tau_{i->j}) -> UC_j | bottom_C^{type} | bottom_C^{adm} | bottom_C^{trace}
handoff_operator.definition: A typed transition rule that carries a scoped unresolved continuation candidate across a declared domain transition only when type compatibility, admissibility context, residue trace, and orientation-reference continuity are preserved.

failure_outputs.bottom_C_type: Produced when source and target domains lack a declared transition type.
failure_outputs.bottom_C_adm: Produced when the target admissibility context cannot admit the carried continuation candidate.
failure_outputs.bottom_C_trace: Produced when declared trace invariants or orientation-reference continuity are not preserved.

trace_preservation.definition: The declared invariant set that must remain recoverable before and after a domain transition.
trace_preservation.preservation_rule: Trace preservation holds only when each required invariant remains recoverable after applying H_adm.
trace_preservation.collapse_rule: If any required invariant is missing, aliased, or contradicted, the handoff yields bottom_C^{trace} rather than a lawful continuation object.

orientation_reference_continuity.definition: A declared compatibility relation between source and target orientation references under a projection-boundary transition.

validation_obligations: Construct a positive typed handoff example across two declared projection domains.
Construct a type-failure counterexample where no tau_{i->j} is declared.
Construct a trace-failure counterexample where residue or orientation-reference invariants are lost.
Audit existing typed-continuation-domain rules for compatibility with H_adm.
Define whether H_adm composes associatively across more than one projection boundary.
